description: Disliked the keeping-back and agreed to it, and read Trinity term off the almanac.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Asked about the Master, and agreed to the keeping-back while saying he disliked it.
name: George Bryan

description: Asked about keeping takings back, took the agreement without a figure, and shut the almanac.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept the king at Michaelmas, and refused to fill the eighteen days with another Errors.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took the cue, and said he would walk the twelve paces once in the yard.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Claimed the hat, got out of the doorway, and stayed for cold meat in the tiring-house.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked what part he has, was told nothing is cast, and accepted that nothing was being hidden.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said it is in the chronicle, said the parts are not cast, and named no sum.
name: William Shakespeare
